Netrias | Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineer, Senior AI Researcher, AI Researcher | Cambridge, MA, Bethesda, MD | ONSITE (US, hybrid) | Full-time | www.netrias.com/careers Netrias is a fast-growing Artificial Intelligence (AI) company that specializes in the application of machine learning models for data harmonization and curation. We apply these technologies within the biopharma and life sciences domains, and are increasingly expanding the domains and applications we can apply them to. We are hiring across several positions - from entry level to senior - to support the development and deployment of technology for our biopharma and life sciences customers focusing on: - Data harmonization and curation 
- Machine learning and predictive modeling We have several new, exciting efforts that we are looking for support on. Are you, or someone you know, passionate about multi-omics data integration and AI-ready data? If so, please reach out! To learn more and apply: www.netrias.com/careers
